subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in columns A, B and C to write five complete
stimulus: sentences. 1×5= 5 Column A Column B Column C (a) Facebook is an Internet (i) Internet connection (i) gain access to Facebook may (b) Nowadays, Facebook (ii) using Facebook (ii) among people living has become anywhere (c) It contributes much (iii) based social network (iii) to facilitate the official works (d) People are also (iv) to maintain social and (iv) connecting people friendly relationship worldwide (e) Everybody having (v) an important part (iv) of our daily life
guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Facebook is an Internet based social network connecting people worldwide. (b) Nowadays, Facebook has become an important part of our daily life. (c) It contributes much to maintain social and friendly relationship among people living anywhere. (d) People are also using Facebook to facilitate the official works. (e) Everybody having Internet connection may gain access to Facebook.
